title: Qaid khane ko
body:
qaid khane ko azakhana banane waali
mar gayi sog bhare ghar ka manane waali
<<DIVIDER>>
hai nami kaisi ye zindan ki deewaron mein
siskiyan kiski hai ye shaam ke bazaaron mein
kya abhi chup na hui ashk bahane waali
qaid khane ko azakhana...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke kehti thi manaun mai bhala gham kaise
ammu batlaiye aakhir karun matam kaise
haath bandhwa bhi chuki khaak udane waali
qaid khane ko azakhana...
<<DIVIDER>>
door tak aaj ujaala hi ujaala hai jahan
ek din sirf andhera hi andhera tha wahan
qaid thi aansuon ki shamma jalane waali
qaid khane ko azakhana...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas honton pe to aankhon mein dhuan leke gayi
apne chehre pe tamachon ke nishan leke gayi
aag jalte huwe kurte ki bujhane waali
qaid khane ko azakhana...
<<DIVIDER>>
ban gayi rassi to jaana ke aseeri kya hai
sayliyan khaayi to samjhi ke yateemi kya hai
har ghadi pyaar chacha jaan ka paane waali
qaid khane ko azakhana...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi behte huwe ashkon se wazu karti thi
ghame sarwar mein kabhi dil ko lahoo karti thi
apne baba ke musalle ko bichane waali
qaid khane ko azakhana...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaake dikhlayegi sab zakhme jigar dadi ko
roke batlayegi roodad e safar dadi ko
berida shaam ke darbar mein jaane waali
qaid khane ko azakhana...
<<DIVIDER>>
jism par khoon bhare kurte ka kafan leke gayi
beete zakhmon ki tarha yaad e watan leke gayi
khabr ghurbat ka parindo ko sunane waali
qaid khane ko azakhana...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat din aamir o nayyar bhi na kyun ashk bahaye
soch le uske masayab to kaleje phat jaaye
marsiya ban ke har ek saans pe chaane waali
qaid khane ko azakhana...
author: Nayyar Jalalpuri
